title: The COZY CASA Welcomes You--Covered Parking!
description:
Welcome to The Cozy Casa, a modern getaway 10-15 minutes  mins from Downtown Nashville and the airport. Mall and parks within 10 mins; 5-10 mins to restaurants, fast food, grocery stores and dollar stores.

Relaxing, quiet & cozy space for 2 guest with amenities (see description). NOT handicap accessible.

Guest access
Separate entrance with keypad access. Park under the carport and enter through side entrance.

During your stay
I frequently travel for work, please call me for further assistance.

Other things to note
Water and coffee is available (free).
